authority: Build17 adds proof-only launch-completion handshake and launching-app diagnostics. Display-change stop, filter, geometry, and product path remain unchanged. Instance equality is correlation to later BSD samples, not event-time capture. Display diagnostics have no decision authority; immediate notification stop is unchanged. Option C admits only an exactly witnessed empty-bundle WindowServer to the proof inventory and reduces the proof claim; product filter and capture selection are byte-identical.

clock.position: after readJoin, before prepareHome and every helper/Chrome/inventory action
clock.eventTime: actual completion of the fixed marker read, passed as at to the existing journal; elapsedMs is later emission time
clock.correlation: lower = driver write-before - app eventElapsedMs; upper = driver receive - app eventElapsedMs. Write-after is retained but not assumed to precede the app event or receipt. Intersect with later baseline interval; never a point offset or authority.

inventoryRefusal.attempt: positive session-wide integer, incremented at every read/baseline entry including successful attempts; gaps allowed
inventoryRefusal.oneRowPerFailedAttempt: first concrete refusal only; outer fallback cannot overwrite it. All failed retries retained. Successful attempts emit no refusal.
inventoryRefusal.pid: signed Int32 or null; affected owner PID, not necessarily valid or verified
inventoryRefusal.windowID: UInt32 or null; exact failed window when the branch singles one out; owner-wide failures may have multiple windows and keep null

signingIdentifier.value: string only when present; otherwise null
signingIdentifier.bytes: UTF8 byte count for observed string, null for unavailable
signingIdentifier.validation: 1..255 bytes; ASCII A-Z a-z 0-9 hyphen and dot only; at least two nonempty dot-separated labels; no label starts or ends with hyphen

inventoryRefusal.signingIdentifierSourceRule: unavailable when absent; verified only if attached owner.verified is true and its identifier equals the observed identifier; otherwise tentative. Tentative metadata is never a successful identity assertion.
inventoryRefusal.owner: null, or exact keys pid,parent,effectiveUID,realUID,savedUID,startSeconds,startMicroseconds,verified,appleAnchored,sysctlBound,hashBytes. PID/parent signed Int32, UIDs UInt32 (real/saved nullable), starts UInt64, hashBytes nonnegative integer, three flags JSON booleans. No path or hash bytes.
inventoryRefusal.cg: up to first 2 affected rows: windowID UInt32, pid Int32, layer Int, rect
inventoryRefusal.sck: up to first 2 affected rows: windowID UInt32, pid Int32|null, ownerPresent boolean (pid != null), bundle same identifier codec, layer Int, rect
inventoryRefusal.rowSelection: window branch selects rows by windowID regardless of PID to preserve mismatches. Owner branch selects all rows by PID; counts record truncation. No window is invented for a pre-owner-map refusal.
inventoryRefusal.rect: object with x,y,width,height numbers; nonfinite source values become null rather than invalid JSON. Negative/zero source dimensions remain evidence.
inventoryRefusal.eventTime: time of first refusal before delivery; actual eventElapsedMs preserved even if emission is later
inventoryRefusal.content: No title, path, window content, URL, prompt text or arbitrary error string.

timingBasis.overlap: Driver queries overlap app work; do not sum these measurements. Per-baseline cheap check durations are unmeasured in this app contract.

baselineChange: App runner-baseline remains 5 seconds after the 10-second capture limit is armed. The withdrawn 45-second proposal is not implemented. V8 moves full static Chrome9/25 before capture and uses a shared bounded2-second dynamic/kernel/BSD/executable-stat baseline; its source requires both reads.
limits: Existing synchronous Security/cleanup/MainActor physical latency limits remain unmeasured. Display sampling is after notification stop, sequential and non-atomic; equal samples cannot exclude an intervening change or establish its cause. First early notifications before the existing indicator observer remain outside notification coverage. Issue4 remains separate.
pins: Build16 signed artifact/driver/wrapper pins pending. Helper12 immutable artifact13392888076 and Swift full SHA85ef7c16e6542d94b26051ba1e04e6df12da7317923726943e4ff292c75a1e89 unchanged; no dispatch until cross-artifact table and both reads.

fields.status: null or signed Int32; actual native static-validity status only when available

surfaceRefusal.journal: actual unchanged ScreenRunnerJournal; normal schema/case/eventElapsedMs envelope
surfaceRefusal.multiplicity: at most one per surface launch attempt; actual surface caller creates one attempt per case
surfaceRefusal.order: after preflight+clock anchor; before or during helper construction; record occurs before generic first-cause/terminal; no fabricated successful spawn
surfaceRefusal.semantics: diagnostic-only; first observation retained, no verdict/identity/selection/signal authority; combined native requirement failure labelled role, not guessed identifier/team; policy identifier/team only for actual caller-policy failure; path for read/static-create/path comparison failure; hash for executable SHA mismatch; operation fallback for otherwise unclassified constructor failure
surfaceRefusal.privacy: fixed enum strings and nullable status only; no path/title/content/exception strings

changeScope: Build16 bounded display diagnostics, exactly witnessed WindowServer structural-refusal category and claim reduction, build number16. No stop suppression, filter modification, other owner exception or bound extension.

fields.label: window-server
fields.pairedWindowIDs: display only: sorted unique nonzero UInt32 array1..64

structuralRefusal.witness: file-restricted creation by actual boundary after existing verified/apple/platform/slice/fullcredential binding and exact CG/SCK pairs; complete current genuine target set only; raw empty bundle included in fingerprint without diagnostic titles
structuralRefusal.claim: Every actual protected target must refuse before construction under one disjoint category. Structural WindowServer gives no protected-owner-predicate evidence; allOwnerProtectedPredicatesDemonstrated false and that stronger claim FAILED_TO_DEMONSTRATE. No ownership, selection, signaling or cleanup authority. Other system corner cases are limitations, not new exceptions.

displayDiagnostics.stop: Exact existing invoke(sourceChanged,displayChange) runs to completion before observation admission or sampling; each notification always stops; no debounce or suppression. Existing observer registration order stays. Sampler task admitted boundedly after stop.
displayDiagnostics.origin: originBeforeJournalMs maps one ContinuousClock origin preceding activation to journal.began; row eventElapsedMs is emission, not historical observation. requestedMs/startedMs/finishedMs are actual offsets from this origin; never exact cross-process equality. Existing causal clock-anchor contract remains.

observationFields.trigger: one of eight milestones or notification
observationFields.reportedCount: actual nonnegative screen count or null if unfinished

screenFields.colorNameBytes: UTF8 length only, no raw unknown name; null if absent
screenFields.mode: null or exact id(Int32),flags(UInt32),width/height/pixelWidth/pixelHeight(nonnegative ints),refreshRate(finite or null)

displayDiagnostics.loss: Admission duplicate/notification excess, display count above8, malformed completion or unfinished at finish fail journal evidence closed; no fake complete; pending tasks do not query after closure. All rows use unchanged4096/1MiB journal limits.
displayDiagnostics.privacy: No title/path/window content, monitor serial/UUID, profile path/name, EDID or arbitrary error. Only fixed color labels/model/component count and unknown name byte length; this does not establish exact profile identity.
displayDiagnostics.limitations: No initiator attribution, no atomic display snapshot, no physical timeout on SDK/MainActor calls. Late samples can miss transient changes. Diagnostic next-run exception may observe recurrence; it cannot alone establish why notification fired or authorize stop weakening.
displayDiagnostics.volume: 218rows maximum:24*(one header+8screens)+origin+closed. Actual encoder max-row and full app journal envelope budget still to be measured in hosted synthetic fixture; no fit claim yet.
displayDiagnostics.milestoneMeaning: before/after-activation-policy bracket the setActivationPolicy call, not didBecomeActive. helper-spawned is post-constructor/recorded-identity, not a ready-message or on-screen witness. indicator-ordered requests a sample after panel ordering and observer registration, not the exact ordering-call timestamp. All request/start/end times are observations only.

originFields.originBeforeJournalMs: finite nonnegative duration from recorder origin to journal.began

launchHandshake.instanceEquality: NSRunningApplication.isEqual between retained notification instance and fresh lookup, bracketed by BSD-before/after matching original owned tuple; repeated before arm
launchHandshake.claim: correlation to later BSD samples; not event-time capture
launchHandshake.productProjection: conditional-compilation byte-equivalent product path vs build16
